items.title: Litton laments missed opportunity after bronze slip
items.summary: Bangladesh won gold at the 2010 Asian Games in Guangzhou before securing bronze medals in the next two editions, in 2014 and 2022.

items.title: ‘Deeply ashamed’: Salahuddin apologises after Bangladesh’s Asian Games failure

items.title: Bronze slips away as Tigers suffer 63-run defeat to Sri Lanka
items.summary: Bangladesh cricketers will return home empty-handed from the Asian Games for the first time after suffering a 63-run defeat to a second-string Sri Lanka in the Bronze-deciding third-place playoff in Nisshin today.

items.title: Ratnayake puts in all-round shift to lead Sri Lanka to bronze medal
items.summary: Bangladesh collapsed with the bat after Tharindu Ratnayake had smashed 65 in 32 balls to take Sri Lanka to a solid 165 for 9

items.title: No more 'picnic tournament', says BCB as revamped NCL begins today
items.summary: A new-look National Cricket League (NCL) gets underway on Saturday across four venues, with the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) introducing several changes in an attempt to revive domestic cricket and make the first-class competition more competitive.
